statement.zh: **协议**：QUIC 传输协议（QUIC）。RFC 9000 §1 说明承载方式与目的：「QUIC packets are carried in UDP datagrams [UDP] to better facilitate deployment in existing systems and networks.」QUIC 因此是运行在 UDP 之上、自带安全与多路复用的传输协议，而不是 TCP 之上的一个加密层。
statement.en: **Protocol**: QUIC (QUIC 传输协议).Section 1 gives the carrier and the motive: "QUIC packets are carried in UDP datagrams [UDP] to better facilitate deployment in existing systems and networks." QUIC is thus a transport over UDP with security and multiplexing built in, not an encryption layer on top of TCP.

statement.zh: 安全与传输参数一次协商：§1 写明「The QUIC handshake combines negotiation of cryptographic and transport parameters.QUIC integrates the TLS handshake [TLS13], although using a customized framing for protecting packets.」。
statement.en: One handshake negotiates both halves: §1 states "The QUIC handshake combines negotiation of cryptographic and transport parameters.QUIC integrates the TLS handshake [TLS13], although using a customized framing for protecting packets."。.

statement.zh: 保护职责由 RFC 9001 规定：「This document describes how QUIC [QUIC-TRANSPORT] is secured using TLS [TLS13].」并说明「QUIC [QUIC-TRANSPORT] assumes responsibility for the confidentiality and integrity protection of packets.」密钥有明确的丢弃时点：客户端首次发送 Handshake 包、服务器首次成功处理 Handshake 包时「MUST discard Initial keys」。
statement.en: RFC 9001 carries the protection rules: "This document describes how QUIC [QUIC-TRANSPORT] is secured using TLS [TLS13]." and "QUIC [QUIC-TRANSPORT] assumes responsibility for the confidentiality and integrity protection of packets." Key discarding is explicit: a client and a server "MUST discard Initial keys" at the first Handshake packet sent or successfully processed.A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records.

statement.zh: 版本协商是不受保护的一环：§12.1 记载「Version Negotiation packets have no cryptographic protection」，Retry 包只用 AEAD 函数防偶然修改；§6.2 对本版本留下「How to perform version negotiation is left as future work」的说明，即版本 1 没有可证明不被降级的版本协商。
statement.en: Version negotiation is the unprotected part: §12.1 records that "Version Negotiation packets have no cryptographic protection", Retry packets only carry an AEAD integrity function against modification, and §6.2 notes for this version that "How to perform version negotiation is left as future work" — so version 1 offers no downgrade-proof negotiation.

statement.zh:
RFC 9000 与配套的 RFC 9001 同为 2021 年 5 月的 Standards Track 文件（前者编辑为 J.Iyengar 与 M.Thomson，后者为 M.Thomson 与 S.Turner），两份头部都没有 Updates 或 Obsoletes 行；本文件定义的是「version 1 of QUIC」。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\)。输入：输入：QUIC 传输协议的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。
statement.en: RFC 9000 and its companion RFC 9001 are both May 2021 Standards Track documents (edited by Iyengar and Thomson, and by Thomson and Turner respectively); neither header carries an Updates or Obsoletes line, and the document defines version 1 of QUIC.
